explanation: On one account the euro is the mechanism of the crisis: interest rates far below what Portugal had known drew in a decade of capital that went into non-tradable sectors, productivity stalled, and when the flow stopped the country had neither the growth to service the debt nor a currency to devalue.

dispute.text: Others put the weight on choices rather than the currency: fiscal policy through the 2000s, the cost of the bank rescues, and the loss of market confidence in 2010 and 2011 in a general European panic. On that reading a country outside the euro with the same accounts would have arrived somewhere similar by a different road.
